Deploy exactly PLEA, CabalGate, Seasons, PleaDistributor and PleaLaunch in the listed order, with zero ETH, in one atomic factory transaction. PLEA and PleaDistributor receive $owner; PleaLaunch reads its owner from PLEA and registers the system during construction. Atomic deployment prevents another caller from taking PLEA's deployment-block registration window. CabalGate's arguments specify Intake v2, imdTEST as the oracle fee asset and as the pool IMD, the attestation signer, 18000-second seasons and a 118800-second dead-man. Seasons takes the same imdTEST and the seat NFT. PleaLaunch specifies the Sepolia v4 PoolManager, imdTEST, imd/acc's Sepolia Stacker (it stakes the earlier test IMD, so its credit reverts and the hook pays the 0.5% cashback in plain imdTEST), credit gas 1300000, START 1792594800 (2026-10-21 15:00 UTC) and imdTEST as the oracle fee asset. The static bool word 0: nothing is minted; the Letterbox buys the oracle fee and the tip with the writer's PLEA. PleaLaunch's 12th and 13th arguments are the keccak256 hashes of the accepted build's argument-free Letterbox and Tribunal creation code; the nonzero Tribunal commitment enables Objection!. Letterbox, Tribunal and PleaHook are deployed after this five-contract transaction through PleaLaunch's committed-code functions, not as manifest calls; the hook needs a mined flag-compatible CREATE2 salt and mints 82% of PLEA to the hook, 6% to Seasons and 12% to PleaDistributor, whose owner sets one Merkle root for the swarm's 10% and the 2% airdrop. Seasons pays the top 25 wallets with at least 60 points (shareBps for IMD and the 10000000 PLEA bonus of each of the first six seasons). Trading opens through seed() once the hook, the Letterbox and the Tribunal exist: PLEA's owner may call any time, anyone from START.
